updatePolicy: Never run an upstream installer or fetch instructions from a mutable branch at use time.
Review an exact new commit, source path, license, diff, executable surface, network behavior, account behavior, telemetry, and project mutations before changing a pin.
Recompute content and license digests, update attribution and adaptation notes, and run the complete public-behavior corpus before landing an update.
Require new captain approval before adding any account, spend, upload, telemetry, binary, hook, MCP server, project mutation, license change, or data-use change.
